prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers stated they were uninjured at the scene. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be directed to their office. Notice of representation placed in file. Claimant reports concussion symptoms including headache, dizziness, and light sensitivity, and has been referred to a neurologist. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Liability review in progress. Insured's dashcam footage shows the other vehicle drifting toward the insured lane before contact. Preliminary assessment places majority fault on the other driver. Recorded statements taken from both drivers and one independent witness. Witness confirms no turn signal was activated.

Entry 4: Counsel submitted medical records indicating a concussion diagnosis and a recommended course of follow-up care. Records reviewed and logged. Injury claim flagged for bodily injury evaluation. Requested updated treatment notes and work status documentation through counsel. Reserve adjusted to reflect injury exposure.

Entry 5: Counsel acknowledged receipt of the information request and advised that the claimant is still undergoing treatment. Follow-up scheduled for next review period. Liability position remains unchanged. Injury evaluation remains open pending completion of medical treatment and receipt of outstanding records.
